subject.title: feat: add selectable outlined message layout

question: Should ClickClack add and maintain an optional outlined message-chain mode as a core device-local Appearance setting?
rationale: Correctness can be assessed from the patch, but whether another persistent chat presentation mode belongs in the core settings surface requires product and UX ownership.

options.title: Accept the opt-in layout
options.body: Keep standard as the default, resolve the conflicts, and land outlined mode after refreshed validation.

options.title: Narrow the presentation change
options.body: Request a smaller visual-consistency adjustment that does not add a persistent layout selector.

options.title: Decline the additional mode
options.body: Keep one canonical message layout to avoid expanding the long-term settings and CSS compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in layout
recommendation.body: Keep standard as the default, resolve the conflicts, and land outlined mode after refreshed validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and the clearest available owner to confirm or decline the new Appearance surface.
